nhve01.title: Aries' holidays
nhve01.caption: Aries in 2016 opened every gift by 5 AM, including the ones with someone else's name on them. Aries in 2026 sits on its hands and lets you go first. Growth looks like vibrating quietly.

nhve02.title: Taurus' holidays
nhve02.caption: 2016 Taurus guarded the cookie plate under a blanket. 2026 Taurus bakes a whole tray for your family first, and one spare, obviously. Who in your life is a cookie hoarder turned cookie sharer?

nhve03.title: Gemini's holidays
nhve03.caption: Three parties, one night, zero real conversations. Then Gemini found one couch and one person and the clock just kept jumping. Are you a three-parties person or a five-more-minutes person?

nhve04.title: Cancer's holidays
nhve04.caption: Cancer cooked for twenty and nobody asked how Cancer was doing. This year someone took the spoon and asked first. Tag the friend who always hosts and never sits down.

nhve05.title: Leo's holidays
nhve05.caption: 2016 Leo spelled its own name in lights and blinded the whole street. 2026 Leo turns the spotlight around and points it at you. Still bright, just better aimed.

nhve06.title: Virgo's holidays
nhve06.caption: Virgo spent the 2016 party at the sink and missed the gift swap entirely. This year the dishes stayed dirty and Virgo stayed on the couch. Which one are you at a party: dancer or dish duty?

nhve07.title: Libra's holidays
nhve07.caption: Libra couldn't pick a gift in 2016, so it bought all six and buried its date in boxes. In 2026 it just asked what would make them feel loved, and wrote the answer down. Revolutionary.

nhve08.title: Scorpio's holidays
nhve08.caption: Scorpio solved the whole secret gift swap in 2016, out loud, in front of everyone. In 2026 it uses the same detective skills to remember the one thing you mentioned in spring. Scary. Romantic.

nhve09.title: Sagittarius' holidays
nhve09.caption: 2016 Sag sent a summit selfie to the family dinner and left an empty chair. 2026 Sag walks in with snowy boots, a bag of stories and someone new to meet. Which one is your Sag this year?

nhve10.title: Capricorn's holidays
nhve10.caption: Capricorn said after this email four times and missed the whole holiday party. This year the laptop got a sticky note and Capricorn got a dance floor. Badly, on purpose.

nhve11.title: Aquarius' holidays
nhve11.caption: Aquarius threw an anti-holiday party around a cactus in 2016 and confused every guest. Same cactus now, plus lights, two stockings and someone who thinks it is perfect. Weird lasts when it is shared.

nhve12.title: Pisces' holidays
nhve12.caption: 2016 Pisces wrote a ten-page card and filed it in a drawer with all the others. 2026 Pisces read it out loud by the tree, and now there are two of them crying. Who is getting your card this year?

nhve13.title: The party invite
nhve13.caption: Two maybes, two couches, one party neither of you went to. In 2026 someone asked the real question and got a real yes. What is the maybe you need to turn into a question?

nhve14.title: The holiday gift
nhve14.caption: One month in and the 2016 gift was a bear too big for the doorway. The 2026 gift was the pen they always borrow. Biggest reaction, smallest box. What is the best small gift you ever got?

nhve15.title: The holiday photo
nhve15.caption: In the 2016 group photo the crush was technically there, cropped and half hidden behind a thumb. In 2026 it is a photo-booth strip with both of you in every frame. Frame all of them.

nhve16.title: Before the break
nhve16.caption: 2016: a wave through the train window, then fourteen days of wondering. 2026: one honest question on the platform before the doors close. Ask before the break, your winter will thank you.

nhve17.title: Meeting the family
nhve17.caption: Virgo showed up to meet the family in 2016 with index cards and dropped all of them on the doorstep. In 2026 it asked grandma about her cookies and left with the recipe. Curious beats rehearsed.

nhve18.title: The holiday party dance
nhve18.caption: Libra spent the whole 2016 party glued to a wall, holding cocoa like a shield. In 2026 it asked someone to dance and warned them it was bad at it. Both were. Nobody cared.

nhve19.title: The holiday text
nhve19.caption: In 2016 the crush got the same happy holidays text as two hundred other people. In 2026 they got one message about a walk in the first snow, and replied in a second. Who gets your one text?

nhve20.title: The countdown
nhve20.caption: 2016 Leo counted down to midnight alone, refreshing a chat that never answered. 2026 Leo was so busy talking on a rooftop it looked up at 12:03. Best midnight ever missed.

nhve21.title: The holiday sweater
nhve21.caption: Matching itchy sweaters for the photo in 2016: one smile, one frown. In 2026 a handmade one with a sleeve that drags on the floor, and Capricorn wears it everywhere. Love is not symmetrical.

nhve22.title: Whose family?
nhve22.caption: 2016 was the holiday tug-of-war: two dinners, two desserts, late to both. 2026 is a sticky note on the fridge with lunch, dinner and a walk home that belongs to just you two. How do you split the day?

nhve23.title: The snow day
nhve23.caption: Aquarius watched the 2016 snow day through the window and texted cute snow. In 2026 it went out and helped build the most lopsided snow-star on the block. Cold hands. Totally worth it.

nhve24.title: The holiday wish
nhve24.caption: Pisces made one wish at the window in 2016: someone to spend the holidays with. Ten years later the table is full, the same star winks back, and yes, Pisces is crying again. Who is at your table this year?
